parts.script:
Sarah: Hey, Tom! Have you thought about where we should go for the weekend? I really need a break from work.  
Tom: Absolutely! I was thinking about the lake house. It's been ages since we last went there.  
Sarah: That sounds perfect! We could go hiking and maybe have a bonfire in the evening.  
Tom: Yes, we can also take some board games. Do you remember the last time we played? It was so much fun!  
Sarah: I do! Also, we should pack some food. What do you think we should bring?  
Tom: How about sandwiches and some snacks? We could also take a cooler with drinks.  
Sarah: Good idea! Should we invite Karen and Mike too?  
Tom: Definitely! The more, the merrier. I can text them and check if they’re available.  
Sarah: Great! Let’s finalize our plans by tomorrow, so we have enough time to prepare.  
Tom: Sounds good! I’ll look up the weather forecast as well.  
Sarah: Perfect! I can’t wait to relax by the lake!  
Tom: Me too! It’ll be a nice change of scenery.
